facts.fact: The policy repo rate is 5.50% (RBI home page, still so on 28 Oct 2026)
The repo rate was already 5.50% on 14 October 2026 (the as-on date in the expected answer)
facts.quote: The next meeting of the MPC is scheduled for December 2 to 4, 2026.
facts.note: Derived: the rate was raised to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026 and the next MPC meeting is 2-4 Dec 2026, so it was 5.50% on 14 Oct; the RBI home page still shows 5.50% on 28 Oct 2026.

facts.fact: It was last changed at the MPC meeting of 5-7 October 2026 (resolution dated 7 October 2026)
facts.quote: Date : Oct 07, 2026 Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee October 5 to 7, 2026

facts.fact: The MPC unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%
facts.quote: the MPC voted unanimously to increase the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) by 25 bps to 5.50 per cent.

facts.fact: The stance was changed to 'calibrated tightening'
facts.quote: The MPC also decided to change the stance to calibrated tightening.

facts.fact: Consequently SDF is 5.25%, and MSF and Bank Rate are 5.75%
facts.quote: Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate stands adjusted at 5.25 per cent and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and the Bank Rate at 5.75 per cent.

facts.fact: The previous review (August 2026) kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, so October's hike was from 5.25%
facts.quote: the MPC voted unanimously to keep the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) unchanged at 5.25 per cent.

facts.fact: The next MPC meeting is on 2-4 December 2026
facts.quote: The next meeting of the MPC is scheduled for December 2 to 4, 2026.

summary: RBI home page (28 Oct 2026) still shows repo 5.50%; the 7 Oct 2026 MPC resolution confirms the 25 bps hike from 5.25%, the new stance, SDF/MSF and the 2-4 Dec meeting.
